{"source_id":"MS002-SRC-A","verdicts":[
{"claim_id":"CL-0451","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0774 states most companies running ads do not treat leads with time, energy and respect and only get a small fraction back, and EV-0776/EV-0777 give the $10,000 spend / $20,000 return 2x ROAS 'quite poor' example.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0774","EV-0776","EV-0777"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0452","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0777 and EV-0778 state that treating leads better, responding faster, making it more customized and personalized, and giving the best experience possible before they pay you turns a single dollar into a lot of dollar bills.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0777","EV-0778"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0453","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0779 and EV-0780 state you paid ~$30 cost per meeting, if they're in your calendar you spent $30 on them, and advise checking in immediately, calling ASAP within a few seconds of the form fill, texting and following up.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0779","EV-0780"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0454","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0781 and EV-0782 describe 'we will weave in flows that call leads immediately' and 'intelligent dispositions, which are outcomes such that if we call somebody and maybe they don't pick up, we route them in the right ways to the right places to maximize the probability of them picking up in the future'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0781","EV-0782"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0455","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0782 states they leave voicemails intelligently and dial with good phone numbers to maximize pickup probability, and EV-0783 adds 'we brand them'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0782","EV-0783"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0456","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0784 and EV-0785 state the home services company's revenue went from 3 mil a month to $9 million a month, 300% revenue growth, simply by calling leads ASAP, consistently and repeatedly, with really good dial practices.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0784","EV-0785"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0457","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0786 says S2L/speed to lead lets you squeeze significantly more juice out of leads, and EV-0787 contrasts an average wait of ~10 minutes with ~30 seconds after a speed to lead system.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0786","EV-0787"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0458","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0787 states they'll still be in the same mindset they were when they opted in, and EV-0788 states the longer they wait the lower the likelihood they'll actually want to engage in the offer.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0787","EV-0788"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0459","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0789 names the event 'intent demonstrated' and EV-0790 states it can be demonstrated in any way — form fill, phone call, email to your brand, or SMS.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0789","EV-0790"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0460","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0791 states immediately after getting the message they send a text/SMS and an email, both AI customized based off form fill information, and EV-0791/EV-0792 list name, why they signed up, challenges, and whatever is collected on ad opt-ins.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0791","EV-0792"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0461","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0792 mentions extending to a merged call, EV-0793 states services assist in the merging of call and that it is more intense software with somebody in a call center constantly merged into calls with people that just filled out a form, and EV-0794 states the person on the other end doesn't have to wait.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0792","EV-0793","EV-0794"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0462","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0795 and EV-0796 describe the roommate's website promise to call within 30 or maybe 60 seconds and his immediate text 'just saw you filled out the form, I'm going to give you a ring in a second', and EV-0797 gives the follow-up email and the immediate call via an automated phone merge.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0795","EV-0796","EV-0797"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0463","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0798 says 'no more perishable leads', reach people in just a few minutes, not wait an hour, and EV-0799 adds not wait the next day and that the amount of money the business makes is directly contingent on all of this.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0798","EV-0799"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0464","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0802 and EV-0803 state these are exactly the sorts of companies a speed to lead flow crushes for — they tend to be home services, blue collar, and really boring businesses you never would have considered.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0802","EV-0803"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0465","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0804/EV-0805 show the Claude-built HTML artifact demo form, EV-0807 shows wiring in an endpoint, and EV-0808 states that without something like this the page can't send an email directly and that he uses Form Scree, totally free, taking like two seconds to sign up.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0804","EV-0805","EV-0807","EV-0808"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0466","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0812 states he will make the 'anything we should know' field mandatory because he wants to use AI to take that information and weave it into a cool email reply template.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0811","EV-0812"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0467","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0813 describes the flow starting with the lead filling out the ad then a polling system constantly checking email for emails that look like form fills, and EV-0814 states if they exist an email is sent to that address immediately and an SMS is personalized.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0813","EV-0814"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0468","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0815 mentions spreading it out, EV-0816 states if you do this too fast people will think it is fake so you have to be in the bounds of reason, could be like 30 seconds, and you could insert a little spelling mistake as many people do, and EV-0817 says they do stuff like that to make it seem more realistic.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0815","EV-0816","EV-0817"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0469","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0820 recommends doing this through a Gmail connector directly by going to connector then Gmail, and EV-0821 states he continues, selects all, and can then read, compose and send emails from Gmail.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0820","EV-0821"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0470","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0823 and EV-0824 state the need for a polling system that actively checks the mailbox once every minute for new entries not already in the old list, and that two things are needed: a way to verify these are new, and a way to take that information and immediately send an email back.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0823","EV-0824"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0471","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0825/EV-0826 give the 're first name ... air conditioning' subject line and the body saying he just saw the form fill with a paraphrased version of the request, and EV-0826/EV-0827 give 'I or someone on my team will call you in the next five minutes'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0825","EV-0826","EV-0827","EV-0828"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0472","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0828 states SMS should be way shorter due to the 160 character constraint, EV-0829 says they must be very careful about how many characters, and EV-0832 states making it even shorter to minimize the probability it spills with AI variable fills including a really long name.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0828","EV-0829","EV-0830","EV-0831","EV-0832"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0473","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0833 instructs a paraphrased version of the request at maximum like 10 or maybe 15 words, keep it really short since the shorter it is the more human it seems, and EV-0834 instructs sending the email really casually formatted just like provided and not straying from the template.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0833","EV-0834"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0474","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0835/EV-0836 identify Qo, formerly Open Phone, requiring an American business, American bank account and a phone number for legitimacy purposes, and EV-0837 gives the Twilio alternative with A2P verification/registration averaging 2 days to 7 or 14 days and possible rejection.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0835","EV-0836","EV-0837"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0475","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0837 and EV-0838 state A2P is a relatively new requirement by the American government to ensure there isn't tremendous amounts of phone spam and that because of spam message increases you now have to wait.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0837","EV-0838"]}
]}
